workResult.summary: Executed only Skill 04 Research Analysis after fail-closed admission, deterministic verification of the authoritative Analysis prompt SHA-256, complete reading of all seven required control/editorial/evidence sources, a durable same-date Wake Receipt, repository-granted global-serial execution authority and a verified Worker Claimed event. Consumed only the three completed 2026-08-18 Reading Results and produced exactly three Research Objects. Q-20260818-01 concludes that accountable human approval must be qualified by receiver-controlled origin provenance separately from user-role content; the demonstrated A2A rejection closes a remote-peer self-approval path but does not prove the positive human authentication and authorization chain. Q-20260818-02 concludes that persistence and reconciliation are separate durable-work responsibilities: preserved work still needs external-change detection, durable object-level change identity, lifecycle reconciliation and isolated retry ownership, without implying distributed exactly-once execution or consensus. Q-20260818-03 concludes that request lifecycle telemetry and external-effect certainty are separate evidence planes: a terminal span can establish the instrumented request outcome while an external side effect may remain unknown and require separate authoritative effect evidence or reconciliation. No article drafting, visualization, Publication Candidate creation or publication was performed.
workResult.summary_zh: 在完成 Fail-closed Admission、权威 Analysis Prompt SHA-256 的确定性核验、全部 7 个 Required Control/Editorial/Evidence Source 的完整读取、同日 Wake Receipt 持久核验、仓库授予的全局串行执行权与 Worker Claimed 核验后，仅执行 Skill 04 Research Analysis。只消费 2026-08-18 当日三份已完成 Reading Result，并恰好形成三份 Research Object。Q-20260818-01 的判断是：可追责真人审批必须把接收端控制的 Origin Provenance 与 user-role 内容分开进行资格判断；已演示的 A2A 拒绝机制封闭了远程对端自我审批路径，但没有证明正向真人身份认证与授权链。Q-20260818-02 的判断是：Persistence 与 Reconciliation 是持久工作的两项独立责任；工作被保存后仍需要 External-change Detection、持久 Object-level Change Identity、Lifecycle Reconciliation 与隔离的 Retry Ownership，不能据此推断分布式 Exactly-once 或 Consensus。Q-20260818-03 的判断是：Request Lifecycle Telemetry 与 External-effect Certainty 属于两个独立 Evidence Plane；Terminal Span 可以建立被 Instrument 的请求终态，而外部副作用仍可能未知，需要独立权威 Effect Evidence 或 Reconciliation。未执行文章撰写、可视化、Publication Candidate 创建或发布。

researchObjects.judgment: Human approval should be modeled as an accountable-origin authorization event rather than a property of user-role content; receiver-controlled provenance can fail-close remote-origin approval classes, while positive human authentication and authorization remain separate requirements.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 真人审批应被建模为可追责来源的授权事件，而不是 user-role 内容本身的属性；接收端控制的 Provenance 可以对远程来源审批类别进行 Fail-closed，但正向真人身份认证与授权仍是独立要求。

researchObjects.judgment: Durable agent work should separate persistence from reconciliation: preserved state needs a live mechanism for change detection, object-level change identity, lifecycle discovery and isolated retry ownership, and none of those mechanisms alone proves exactly-once execution or distributed exclusivity.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 持久 Agent Work 应把 Persistence 与 Reconciliation 分开：被保存的状态仍需要活跃机制承担变化检测、对象级变化身份、生命周期发现与隔离 Retry Ownership；这些机制本身都不能证明 Exactly-once Execution 或分布式排他执行。

researchObjects.judgment: Request lifecycle telemetry should reconstruct queue receipt through terminal transport outcome, but external-effect certainty requires a separate authoritative evidence plane; disconnect can be a terminal telemetry state while the external effect remains unknown.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Request Lifecycle Telemetry 应重建从 Queue Receipt 到 Terminal Transport Outcome 的路径，但 External-effect Certainty 需要独立权威 Evidence Plane；Disconnect 可以是 Telemetry 终态，而外部 Effect 仍然未知。
